meta.name: Hazbin Hotel
meta.description: Charlie, the Princess of Hell, opens a hotel to rehabilitate demons and send them to Heaven.

videos.title: That's Entertainment (Pilot)
videos.overview: The original 2019 pilot, which introduced Charlie, Vaggie and Angel Dust.

videos.title: Overture
videos.overview: Charlie introduces the Happy Hotel and her plan to rehabilitate sinners, while the first guests test everyone's patience.

videos.title: Radio Killed the Video Star
videos.overview: Alastor goes back on the air, and the hotel feels the consequences.

videos.title: Masquerade
videos.overview: Angel Dust tries to balance his work and the hotel until an unexpected arrival shakes things up.

videos.title: Dad Beat Dad
videos.overview: Charlie invites her father, Lucifer, to the hotel to ask a favour, with Alastor stirring up trouble.

videos.title: Welcome to Heaven
videos.overview: Charlie and Vaggie travel to Heaven to speak with Adam's manager.

videos.title: Hello Rosie!
videos.overview: Charlie and Vaggie work to protect their home from destruction.

videos.title: The Show Must Go On
videos.overview: The season finale brings the conflict between Heaven and Hell to a head.

videos.title: New Pentious
videos.overview: A month after the Extermination, the hotel fills with new residents.

videos.title: Behind Closed Doors
videos.overview: Charlie sets up an interview with the Vees, with disastrous results.

videos.title: It's A Deal
videos.overview: Alastor leaves the hotel and makes a move to get out of his deal.

videos.title: Scream Rain
videos.overview: Vox prepares for war against Heaven while tensions grow among the hotel's residents.
